pro_course_detail.title: Mexican Spanish and Nahuatl: A Close Relationship
pro_course_detail.description:
ENG
Learn how Mexican Spanish and Nahuatl have influenced each other 🔁

During our lesson, you will learn how these two languages have coexisted for hundreds of years and how one has affected the other. I'll talk to you about our very famous ...and infamous "ahorita" (lol), I'll tell you what's the deal with the abundance of diminutives around here, and we will even touch on the subject of the very commonly used word "güey", which I really don't like.... Do you want to know why? 

I would really like to talk with you about all this, so if it sounds good to you, let's meet soon! 🤓

ESP
Aprende cómo el español mexicano y el náhuatl se han influenciado mutuamente 🔁

Durante nuestra lección, aprenderás cómo estos dos idiomas han coexistido durante cientos de años y cómo uno ha afectado al otro. Te hablaré sobre nuestro muy famoso... e infame "ahorita" (lol), te diré qué pasa con la abundancia de diminutivos por aquí, e incluso tocaremos el tema de la muy usada palabra "güey", que realmente no me gusta... ¿Quieres saber por qué? 

Me gustaría mucho hablar contigo sobre todo esto, así que si te parece bien, ¡nos vemos pronto! 🤓

Stop! ⛔ Clicking on my profile video will save you your valuable time, energy and money if you want to learn Spanish.

5 incredibly common and dangerous ❌ mistakes ❌ that every current or future language learner needs to avoid:

❌1️⃣ You use Spanish less than 90% of the time during class. You think: “If it’s a Spanish class, why is my teacher doing all of the talking in another language?” 🗣️

❌2️⃣ You do the so-called grammar and vocabulary “drills”. You think: “First we must learn the rules and then apply them! That’s how language learning should be, right?” 🤔

Keep reading ----->

Note: Please be aware that I do not teach children under the age of 15 years old.

❌4️⃣ You follow a super specific and cut-and-dried path. You think: "First we learn how to introduce ourselves, then nationalities, then numbers… This is how it must be, correct?" 📝

❌5️⃣ You exert lots of effort to learn. "No pain, no gain!" 💪

❗ Bonus point: You use only one single method to learn. "Just studying with textbooks or just traveling to a Spanish-speaking country is enough, isn’t it!?" ✈️

If you already have an intermediate or advanced level of Spanish, and you would like to improve your conversation skills, this class is for you!

We will talk A LOT about a wide variety of topics, always considering your level and your goals.

You will:

- Get more comfortable to speak
- Learn new vocabulary
- Improve your pronunciation
- Acquire language rules easily
- Have lots of fun!

If there's a particular topic that you want to talk about, feel free to let me know at the beginning of the class and we'll start from there!

pro_course_detail.title: TPRS: Spanish with Stories | From Total Beginners to Advanced Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Come and acquire Spanish with fun, effective and interesting stories!

We will be engaged in entertaining and easy conversations that will help you kickstart or perfect your skills. You will see a lot of progress in a very short time without feeling overwhelmed by the language.

TPRS is a great method if you want to try something different to learn, especially if you have had bad experiences with Spanish learning before. You can learn vocabulary, useful expressions and even grammar quickly! All of this without feeling the pressure or difficulty of traditional learning.

And if you'd like to practice more, I could also give you activities and tasks to practice outside of class time so you can progress and keep acquiring the language faster.

If you are unsure of which lesson to choose, I encourage you to please book a trial lesson first so I can help you :)

pro_course_detail.description:
¡Ven y adquiere inglés con historias divertidas, efectivas e interesantes!

Vamos a mantener conversaciones entretenidas y sencillas que te ayudarán a impulsar o perfeccionar tus habilidades. Verás un gran progreso en muy poco tiempo sin sentirte agobiado por el idioma.

TPRS es un gran método si quieres intentar algo diferente para aprender, especialmente si has tenido malas experiencias con el aprendizaje del idioma inglés en el pasado.
